issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other, Water Fund column 7,075.91
issues.issue: The page says only 'Other'. The extractor assumed these are water charges, which is plausible, but if so the user's 2026-10-28 rule puts utility fund charges in Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. If the assumption is not confirmed, the line belongs in other.
